sources.title: Virtual politician - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: A virtual politician, or AI politician, is an artificial entity seeking or in government office. A virtual politician would have similar power to a human serving in the same position, but would be programmed to make choices based on a purpose-built artificial intelligence.
